rules.unit: one complete round to finishing order
rules.tributeReason: Fresh independent deals, no preceding round; not a tribute or full-match evaluation

pairing: Exactly the same 108 card IDs at the same seats, level and first leader; swap model/team allocation between parity 0 and 1. Mixed focal seat alternates between teammates by seed parity. Both games must complete to count a pair.
pipeline: Native ONNX CPU one thread; raw neural argmax over canonical candidates, no web personality/endgame/finishing shortcut, no Clint heuristics added to neural policies. Clint independent rules-v2 own-hand/public-only.
purpose: Fixed final four-hour fresh-Adam champion fine-tuning versus unchanged initial champion. No web promotion.
primaryInterpretation: Latest perspective; 95% seed-cluster CI for signed single-round upgrade points

analysis.primary: Final-window learner latest vs unchanged initial champion; signed upgrade points with 95% independent deal-pair sample-SD normal CI. No selecting peak/gated snapshot.
analysis.secondary: Two same-deal latest-minus-champion common-opponent/teammate contrasts, each 99% CI. Mixed side is focal neural+Clint against two fixed champions, with unchanged champion+Clint baseline. W/L/D, ranks and double-down reported separately, never pooled win rate.
analysis.stopping: Fixed 10000 complete rounds or one-time three-hour deadline clipped by global compute cutoff. No sample expansion or extension by results. Incomplete pairs never counted as completed acceptance.
analysis.limitations: One fine-tuning run, no optimizer-reset or cache causal ablation; uncertainty covers evaluation deals only, no full-match/tribute/human coaching claim.

contrasts.direction: latest minus champion with Clint teammate against two fixed champions

latest.freezeRule: Exactly final fully stopped learner export after the fixed window; not peak or internal gate champion
